sentences: The swap happens when the current number is bigger than the next number, so the four moves right.
Since the loop only runs for three steps, the four gets pushed all the way to the last position.
Each time a bigger number sits before a smaller one, they swap, so four keeps moving right.
The loop stops at j equal to 2, so the biggest value ends up at the final index.
Only three comparisons happen, which is enough to carry the largest number to the end of the list.
